title: Heart Failure, CPAP, Cardiogenic Shock and Aortic Emergencies
next: Chapter 30, Lesson 4: Cardiac monitoring and the 12-lead ECG

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already sit breathless patients up, give oxygen and assist breathing with a BVM. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Recognize left and right heart failure; tell pulmonary edema from COPD
  2. Use the BC heart failure protocol and CPAP, which only the PCP adds
  3. Spot cardiogenic shock, tamponade, aortic and hypertensive emergencies

Textbook: Chapter 30, PDF pages 2600–2617
slides.say: Welcome back. As EMRs, you already know what to do for a patient who can't breathe: sit them up, give oxygen, and assist ventilations with a bag-valve mask if they tire. Today we look at what happens when the pump itself fails, and at other cardiac killers. Three goals. First, recognize left and right heart failure, and tell cardiac pulmonary edema from COPD. Second, use the BC heart failure protocol, including CPAP, continuous positive airway pressure, which only the PCP adds. Third, spot cardiogenic shock, cardiac tamponade, aortic emergencies, and hypertensive emergencies, and know what's outside your scope.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。作为 EMR，你已经知道喘不上气的病人怎么处理：扶坐起来、给氧，病人累了就用球囊面罩辅助通气。今天看看泵本身衰竭时会发生什么，以及其他几种心血管杀手。三个目标：第一，识别左心衰和右心衰，分清心源性肺水肿和 COPD；第二，用好 BC 心衰流程，包括只有 PCP 才能用的 CPAP，即持续气道正压；第三，识别心源性休克、心包填塞、主动脉急症和高血压急症，并知道哪些不在你的执业范围内。

slides.title: Left or right heart failure?
slides.body:
Left-sidedRight-sided
Backs up intoLungsBody veins
Usual causeMI, chronic high BPLeft failure; chronic lung disease; PE
SignsDyspnea, orthopnea, PND, crackles, pink frothy sputumJVD, ankle or sacral edema, tender liver

About 600,000 Canadians live with heart failure.
slides.say: Heart failure means the heart can't pump hard or fast enough to empty, so blood backs up behind it; about six hundred thousand Canadians live with it. In left-sided failure, usually after a heart attack or years of high blood pressure, the right side keeps pumping, but the left can't keep up. Pressure builds in the lungs, and fluid leaks into the air sacs: cardiogenic pulmonary edema, with breathlessness, orthopnea, PND, crackles, and pink, frothy sputum. In right-sided failure, blood backs up into the body's veins: distended neck veins, swollen feet or lower back, and a tender liver. Right failure most often follows left failure.
slides.sayZh: 心衰是指心脏泵得不够有力或不够快，排不空，血就积在它后面；加拿大约有六十万人患心衰。左心衰通常发生在心梗或多年高血压之后：右心照常泵血，左心却跟不上，肺里压力升高，液体渗进肺泡，这就是心源性肺水肿，表现为气促、端坐呼吸、夜间阵发性呼吸困难、湿啰音和粉红色泡沫痰。右心衰时，血倒灌进全身静脉：颈静脉怒张、脚或腰骶部水肿、肝脏压痛。右心衰最常继发于左心衰。

slides.title: Pulmonary edema or COPD?
slides.body:
Cardiac pulmonary edemaCOPD
Older; heart disease, high BPOften younger; allergies
Orthopnea; rapid weight gainRepeated attacks; recent infection
Missed or reduced water pillDry cough
Crackles, foamy sputum, JVD, edemaHyperinflated chest; silent if severe
Often severe hypertensionAccessory muscles

Both can wheeze. Salbutamol rarely helps a cardiac wheeze and speeds the heart.
slides.say: Both of these patients can wheeze, so how do you tell them apart? The cardiac patient is usually older, with heart disease or high blood pressure, worse lying flat, maybe with quick weight gain, and has often cut back on or missed a water pill. You'll hear crackles, and may see foamy sputum, distended neck veins, swollen ankles, and a very high blood pressure. The COPD patient is often younger, may have allergies, has had attacks like this before, maybe after a chest infection, with a dry cough, an over-inflated chest, and accessory muscle use. Why it matters: salbutamol rarely helps a cardiac wheeze, and it speeds a struggling heart.
slides.sayZh: 这两种病人都可能有哮鸣音，怎么区分？心源性病人通常年纪大，有心脏病或高血压，平躺加重，可能体重短期内快速增加，常常减少或漏服了排水药。你会听到湿啰音，可能看到泡沫痰、颈静脉怒张、脚踝水肿和很高的血压。COPD 病人往往较年轻，可能有过敏史，以前有过类似发作，可能在一次胸部感染之后，干咳、胸廓过度充气、用辅助呼吸肌。为什么要分清？沙丁胺醇对心源性哮鸣很少有用，还会让本已吃力的心脏跳得更快。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: BC heart failure protocol
slides.body:
BC Congestive Heart Failure or Pulmonary Edema protocol (also drowning, cardiogenic shock, toxin exposure)

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Rest: no exertion; bring equipment to the patient
  • Sit upright, legs hanging down
  • Keep warm
  • O₂ to keep SpO₂ ≥ 94%
  • Assist ventilations if LOC altered or SpO₂ < 94%
  • Transport

PCP adds (on scene)

  • Consider CPAP
  • If BVM needed: PEEP valve, 5 cmH₂O to start
slides.say: Here's the BC protocol for congestive heart failure or pulmonary edema; it also covers drowning, cardiogenic shock, and toxic exposures. On the left, every licence level: keep the patient at rest and bring the equipment to them, sit them upright with the legs hanging down, keep them warm, give oxygen to keep the saturation at ninety-four or higher, assist ventilations if their level of consciousness drops or the saturation is below ninety-four, and transport. Legs down lets blood pool in the legs, which lowers preload. On the right, the PCP adds, on scene: consider CPAP, and if bag-valve-mask ventilation is needed, add a PEEP valve, starting at five centimetres of water.
slides.sayZh: 这是 BC 的充血性心衰或肺水肿流程，也适用于溺水、心源性休克和毒物暴露。左栏，所有执照级别：让病人休息，把设备带到病人身边；扶他坐直、双腿下垂；保暖；给氧使血氧维持在九十四以上；意识下降或血氧低于九十四时辅助通气；转运。双腿下垂能让血积在腿上，从而降低前负荷。右栏，PCP 在现场多做：考虑 CPAP；需要球囊面罩通气时加 PEEP 阀，从五厘米水柱开始。

slides.q: An 80-year-old man woke at 3 a.m. gasping. He sleeps on three pillows, has crackles and wheezes in both lungs, swollen ankles, BP 188/104. He ran out of his water pill last week. No lung disease. Which plan is LEAST helpful?
options: Sit him upright with his legs hanging down
Oxygen, and as the PCP, consider CPAP
Treat the wheeze with repeated salbutamol as your main therapy
Keep him at rest and bring the stretcher to him
slides.say: Let's check your thinking. An eighty-year-old man woke at three in the morning gasping. He sleeps on three pillows, has crackles and wheezes in both lungs, swollen ankles, and a blood pressure of one hundred eighty-eight over one hundred four. He ran out of his water pill last week, and has no lung disease. Which plan is least helpful? A, sit him upright with his legs hanging down. B, oxygen, and as the PCP, consider CPAP. C, treat the wheeze with repeated salbutamol as your main therapy. D, keep him at rest and bring the stretcher to him. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来检验一下思路。一位八十岁男性凌晨三点憋醒、大口喘气。他要垫三个枕头睡，双肺有湿啰音和哮鸣音，脚踝水肿，血压一百八十八比一百零四。上周他的排水药吃完了，没有肺病史。哪个方案最没帮助？A 扶他坐直、双腿下垂；B 给氧，作为 PCP 考虑 CPAP；C 以反复给沙丁胺醇治疗哮鸣音为主要措施；D 让他休息，把担架推到他身边。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is C. This is cardiac pulmonary edema: PND, orthopnea, crackles, swollen ankles, high blood pressure, and a missed diuretic. The wheeze is cardiac, so salbutamol rarely helps; it speeds the heart and raises its oxygen demand. A, B and D come straight from the BC heart failure protocol: legs down, oxygen, CPAP for the PCP, and no exertion for the patient.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 C。这是心源性肺水肿：夜间阵发性呼吸困难、端坐呼吸、湿啰音、脚踝水肿、高血压，还漏服了利尿剂。哮鸣音是心源性的，沙丁胺醇很少有用，还会加快心率、增加心肌耗氧。A、B、D 都直接来自 BC 心衰流程：双腿下垂、给氧、PCP 用 CPAP、病人不用力。

slides.title: CPAP: who qualifies
slides.body:
• Age ≥ 13, significant respiratory distress
  • Awake, follows commands, keeps own airway
  • All three: RR > 24, SpO₂ < 94% on O₂, accessory muscles
  • Not if: 12 or under, low LOC, can't follow commands
  • Not if: hypoventilating or failing; mask won't seal
  • Not if: vomiting, trauma, tracheostomy, pneumothorax
  • Not if: systolic < 90
slides.say: CPAP is new for you as a PCP. Fluid in the air sacs makes them collapse; CPAP's steady pressure holds them open, improves gas exchange, and eases the work of breathing. BC notes it reduces intubation and death. Who qualifies? Age thirteen or older, in significant distress, awake, following commands, keeping their own airway, and with all three: breathing over twenty-four a minute, saturation under ninety-four on oxygen, and accessory muscle use. Who doesn't? Twelve or under, a low level of consciousness, slow or failing breathing, a mask that won't seal, vomiting, trauma, a tracheostomy, a pneumothorax, or a systolic under ninety.
slides.sayZh: CPAP 是你作为 PCP 的新工具。肺泡里有液体会塌陷，CPAP 持续的压力把它们撑开，改善气体交换，减轻呼吸做功；BC 指出它能减少插管和死亡。谁适用？十三岁及以上、明显呼吸窘迫、清醒、能听从指令、能自己维持气道，并且三项全有：呼吸每分钟超过二十四次、吸氧下血氧低于九十四、用辅助呼吸肌。谁不适用？十二岁及以下、意识水平下降、呼吸慢或即将衰竭、面罩密封不住、呕吐、外伤、气管切开、气胸，或收缩压低于九十。

slides.title: CPAP: settings and when to stop
slides.body:
1. Start: O₂ 5 L/min, valve at 5 cmH₂O
  2. Seal the mask; reassess patient and vitals
  3. Increase by 2.5 cmH₂O steps, max 10
  • Worse? Remove CPAP → BVM, consider PEEP
  • PEEP: 5, up by 2.5 to max 10; no more than 8–10 breaths/min
  • Systolic < 90 or arrest → remove the PEEP valve
slides.say: Here's how BC runs CPAP. Start oxygen at five litres a minute with the valve at five centimetres of water. Get a good seal, then reassess the patient and the vital signs. Increase in steps of two point five, up to ten. CPAP can lower the blood pressure a little, so recheck it after each change. If the patient gets worse, remove CPAP and ventilate with a bag-valve mask, considering a PEEP valve. PEEP also starts at five and goes up by two point five to ten, usually with no more than eight to ten breaths a minute. If the systolic drops below ninety, or the patient arrests, remove the PEEP valve.
slides.sayZh: BC 这样用 CPAP：氧流量每分钟五升起步，阀门设在五厘米水柱。密封好面罩，然后复评病人和生命体征。需要时每次加二点五，最高到十。CPAP 可能让血压略降，所以每次调整后都要复测。病人变差时，撤掉 CPAP，改用球囊面罩通气，考虑加 PEEP 阀。PEEP 也从五开始，每次加二点五，最高十，通气频率通常不超过每分钟八到十次。收缩压降到九十以下或病人心脏骤停，就取下 PEEP 阀。

slides.title: Cardiogenic shock
slides.body:
Pump failure: ≥ 40% of the left ventricle infarcted

  • Also: after ROSC; beta or calcium channel blocker overdose
  • Confused, cold, pale; crackles; fast, thready pulse
  • SpO₂ often won't read
  • Hypertensive patient can be in shock with systolic > 90
  • Book: lay flat. BC (CHF protocol): sit up, legs down
  • No field fix: short scene time
slides.say: Cardiogenic shock means the heart is too damaged to perfuse the body. When about a quarter of the left ventricle is lost, left heart failure usually develops; at forty percent or more, cardiogenic shock may follow, with a high death rate. It can also follow resuscitation, an overdose of beta blockers or calcium channel blockers, or a heart infection. Look for confusion or restlessness, cold, pale skin, crackles, and a fast, thready pulse; the oximeter often won't read. The systolic may fall below ninety, but a patient with long-standing high blood pressure can be in shock above ninety. The textbook lays them flat unless there's pulmonary edema. But BC lists cardiogenic shock under its heart failure protocol: sit them upright, legs hanging down. Keep scene time short.
slides.sayZh: 心源性休克是心脏损伤太重，无法维持全身灌注。左心室损失约四分之一时，通常出现左心衰；损失百分之四十或更多，就可能发生心源性休克，死亡率很高。它也可能出现在复苏之后、β 阻滞剂或钙通道阻滞剂过量之后，或心肌感染时。表现为意识混乱或烦躁、皮肤湿冷苍白、湿啰音、脉搏快而细弱；血氧仪常测不出。收缩压可能低于九十，但长期高血压的病人收缩压高于九十也可能已经休克。教材让病人平卧，有肺水肿时除外。但 BC 把心源性休克列在心衰协议里：让病人坐直、双腿下垂。现场时间要短。

slides.title: Cardiac tamponade
slides.body:
Fluid in the pericardial sac squeezes the heart: it can't fill.

  • Beck triad: low BP, distended neck veins, muffled heart sounds
  • Narrowing pulse pressure, fast heart rate
  • Best clue: pulsus paradoxus
  • Not tension pneumo: equal breath sounds, trachea midline
  • Cure: drain it in hospital; even 50 mL helps
slides.say: Cardiac tamponade is fluid filling the pericardium, the tough sac around the heart. The sac can't stretch, so the heart can't fill between beats, and output falls. Causes include tumours, inflammation, cancer drugs, and chest trauma, where blood can fill it fast. The classic Beck triad is low blood pressure, distended neck veins, and muffled heart sounds, with a narrowing pulse pressure and a fast heart rate. The best clue is pulsus paradoxus. In trauma, tell it from a tension pneumothorax: in tamponade, breath sounds are equal and the trachea is midline. Draining even fifty millilitres in hospital can help a lot, so transport fast and tell them why you suspect it.
slides.sayZh: 心包填塞是液体充满心包——包在心脏外面那层坚韧的囊。心包撑不开，心脏在两次搏动之间无法充盈，输出量就下降。病因包括肿瘤、炎症、化疗药和胸部外伤，外伤时血液可迅速充满心包。经典的 Beck 三联征是低血压、颈静脉怒张和心音遥远，同时脉压变窄、心率增快。最有用的线索是奇脉。外伤时要和张力性气胸区分：心包填塞时双侧呼吸音对称、气管居中。在医院哪怕只抽出五十毫升也能明显改善，所以要快速转运，并告诉医院你为什么怀疑它。

slides.q: Two days after a large heart attack, a 70-year-old woman has crackles throughout both lungs, RR 32, SpO2 85% on a non-rebreather. She is confused. BP 82/50. You are the PCP. What is the best airway plan?
options: CPAP at 5 cmH2O, then increase to 10
Assist ventilations with a BVM; no PEEP valve while systolic is under 90
Switch to a nasal cannula so you don't lower her BP
slides.say: Time for a PCP decision. Two days after a large heart attack, a seventy-year-old woman has crackles throughout both lungs, breathing thirty-two a minute, saturation eighty-five percent on a non-rebreather. She's confused, and her blood pressure is eighty-two over fifty. What's the best airway plan? A, CPAP at five centimetres of water, then increase to ten. B, CPAP at ten right away. C, assist ventilations with a bag-valve mask, with no PEEP valve while the systolic is under ninety. D, switch to a nasal cannula so you don't lower her blood pressure. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来一道 PCP 决策题。一位七十岁女性，大面积心梗后第二天，双肺满布湿啰音，呼吸每分钟三十二次，用非重复呼吸面罩血氧百分之八十五。她意识混乱，血压八十二比五十。最好的气道方案是什么？A CPAP 从五厘米水柱开始，再加到十；B 直接上 CPAP 十；C 用球囊面罩辅助通气，收缩压低于九十时不加 PEEP 阀；D 改用鼻导管，免得血压再降。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is C. This looks like cardiogenic shock with pulmonary edema, and CPAP is contraindicated twice: a decreased level of consciousness and a systolic under ninety. The BC heart failure protocol says to assist ventilations when consciousness is altered or the saturation is under ninety-four, and BC removes the PEEP valve below a systolic of ninety. A and B ignore the contraindications. D gives less oxygen to a hypoxic patient.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 C。这看起来是心源性休克合并肺水肿，CPAP 有两条禁忌：意识水平下降、收缩压低于九十。BC 心衰流程规定意识改变或血氧低于九十四时辅助通气，而且收缩压低于九十时 BC 要求取下 PEEP 阀。A 和 B 无视禁忌；D 给一个已经缺氧的病人更少的氧。

slides.title: Aortic dissection
slides.body:
Heart attackDissection
OnsetGradual, warning symptomsSudden, peak within 1 min
PainPressure; waxes and wanesTearing; constant
WhereUnder sternum; rarely backOften between shoulder blades
Pulses, BPEqualArm BPs differ; weak pulse

Book: calm, O₂ if hypoxic, IV, monitor, fast transport. Avoid ASA and nitro.
slides.say: An aortic dissection is a tear in the inner lining of the aorta; blood forces its way between the layers, can block branches, and can rupture. The typical patient is a middle-aged or older man with long-standing high blood pressure, but it also happens in pregnancy and in young people with Marfan syndrome. The pain is sudden and tearing, at its peak within a minute, often between the shoulder blades, while a heart attack usually builds gradually. Look for unequal arm pressures, a weak pulse, stroke signs, or heart attack signs. The textbook says: calm, oxygen if hypoxic, IV, monitor, fast transport, and avoid ASA and nitro.
slides.sayZh: 主动脉夹层是主动脉内膜撕裂，血液钻进管壁各层之间，可能堵住分支，也可能破裂。典型病人是长期高血压的中老年男性，但孕期和患马凡综合征的年轻人也会发生。疼痛突然、撕裂样，一分钟内达到顶峰，常在两肩胛之间；而心梗通常是逐渐加重。要找双臂血压不等、一侧脉弱、卒中征象或心梗征象。教材的处理：安抚、缺氧时给氧、开静脉、监护、快速转运，并且避免 ASA 和硝酸甘油。

slides.title: Abdominal aortic aneurysm
slides.body:
• About 2% of people over 65; rupture kills about 80%
  • Typical: man in his late 70s
  • Sudden pain near the navel, or low back pain only
  • Constant; spreads to groin or thigh; may faint first
  • Key sign: pulsating mass in the abdomen

Book: transport now; large IV en route at a keep-open rate; if shock, fluid only to systolic 70–90.
slides.say: An abdominal aortic aneurysm, or triple A, is a ballooning of the aorta, usually just below the kidney arteries. About two percent of people over sixty-five have one, and about eighty percent die if it ruptures. The typical patient is a man in his late seventies with sudden pain around the navel, or only in the lower back, like a pulled muscle or a kidney stone. It's constant, spreads to the groin or thigh, and a leak may cause fainting first. The classic sign is a pulsating abdominal mass. The textbook says: transport now, IV en route at a keep-open rate, and in shock, fluid only to a systolic of seventy to ninety.
slides.sayZh: 腹主动脉瘤（triple A）是主动脉像气球一样鼓出，通常在肾动脉下方。六十五岁以上约百分之二的人有，破裂后约百分之八十会死亡。典型病人是七十多岁后段的男性，突然肚脐周围痛，或只有下腰痛，像拉伤或肾结石。疼痛持续，放射到腹股沟或大腿，渗漏时可能先晕倒。典型体征是腹部搏动性包块。教材的处理：立即转运，途中开静脉、保持通畅速度；如果休克，补液只补到收缩压七十到九十。

slides.title: Hypertensive emergencies
slides.body:
Treat the organ damage, not the number

  • High BP: consistently > 130/80 at rest; normal < 120/80
  • Emergency = sudden rise plus end-organ damage
  • Examples: left heart failure, aortic dissection, encephalopathy
  • Encephalopathy: severe headache, vomiting → seizures, confusion
  • Book: lower by ≤ 1/3 over 30–60 min, in hospital
slides.say: About one in four Canadians has high blood pressure, and almost half of them don't know it. A hypertensive emergency is a sudden rise plus organ damage: left heart failure, aortic dissection, or hypertensive encephalopathy, where very high pressure pushes fluid into the brain. That starts with a severe headache, nausea and vomiting, then seizures and confusion, sometimes blindness, speech problems, or one-sided weakness. The textbook lowers the pressure by no more than a third over thirty to sixty minutes, in hospital. In the field: oxygen if hypoxic, IV, monitor, transport, and be ready for seizures.
slides.sayZh: 加拿大约四分之一的人有高血压，其中近一半自己不知道。高血压急症是血压急升加上器官损害：左心衰、主动脉夹层，或高血压脑病——极高的压力把液体压进脑组织。它先表现为剧烈头痛、恶心呕吐，然后抽搐、意识混乱，有时失明、说话障碍或一侧肢体无力。教材的做法是在医院里、三十到六十分钟内把血压降低不超过三分之一。现场：缺氧时给氧、开静脉、监护、转运，并准备好应对抽搐。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Heart failure O₂: book SpO₂ 90–94% → BC ≥ 94%
  • Book: nitro is the HF mainstay → BC CHF protocol lists no nitro
  • BC nitro indication: chest discomfort that appears cardiac
  • CPAP and PEEP: PCP only in BC
  • Furosemide, morphine, dopamine, labetalol: not on the BC list
  • EMRs: no IV. Book's shock fluid trial: physician order
slides.say: Let's line up the book and BC. In heart failure, the book keeps the saturation at ninety to ninety-four; the BC protocol says ninety-four or higher, and assist ventilations below that. The book calls nitro the mainstay of acute heart failure, but the BC heart failure protocol doesn't list nitro, and the BC nitro indication is chest discomfort that appears cardiac. CPAP and PEEP are PCP only. The book's furosemide, morphine, dopamine, norepinephrine and labetalol are not on the BC EMR or PCP list. And EMRs have no IV; in the book, the cardiogenic shock fluid trial is given on a physician's order.
slides.sayZh: 把书和 BC 对一对。心衰时书里把血氧维持在九十到九十四；BC 流程要求九十四或以上，低于这个就辅助通气。书里说硝酸甘油是急性心衰的主力药，但 BC 心衰流程根本没列硝酸甘油，而且 BC 硝酸甘油的适应症是看起来是心源性的胸部不适。CPAP 和 PEEP 只属于 PCP。书里的呋塞米、吗啡、多巴胺、去甲肾上腺素和拉贝洛尔都不在 BC EMR/PCP 药物清单上。EMR 没有静脉通路权限；书里心源性休克的试验性补液要有医生医嘱。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• CPAP can drop the BP: recheck after every change
  • Systolic < 90: no CPAP, and remove the PEEP valve
  • Cardiac wheeze: don't reach for salbutamol by reflex
  • Hypertensive patient: systolic > 90 can still be shock
  • Tearing pain or unequal arm BPs: no ASA, no nitro
  • Ruptured AAA: IV en route; don't flood with fluid
slides.say: Now the watch-outs that are new at your level. CPAP raises the pressure in the chest and can lower the blood pressure, so recheck it after every change; with a systolic under ninety, no CPAP, and take the PEEP valve off. Don't reach for salbutamol by reflex when a heart failure patient wheezes. A patient with long-standing high blood pressure can be in shock above ninety. If the pain is tearing, or the arm pressures differ, hold the ASA and nitro, and tell the hospital; the BC indications for both describe pain that looks cardiac. And for a ruptured aneurysm, start the IV en route and don't flood the patient with fluid.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲 PCP 层面新的注意事项。CPAP 会升高胸腔内压、降低血压，每次调整后都要复测；收缩压低于九十就不用 CPAP，并取下 PEEP 阀。心衰病人有哮鸣音时，别条件反射地拿沙丁胺醇。长期高血压的病人收缩压高于九十也可能已经休克。疼痛是撕裂样，或双臂血压不等，就不给 ASA 和硝酸甘油，并告诉医院；BC 对这两种药的适应症写的都是看起来是心源性的疼痛。腹主动脉瘤破裂时，途中开静脉，别给病人灌大量液体。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Left failure floods the lungs; right failure swells the body
  2. BC: sit up, legs down, O₂ ≥ 94%; PCP: CPAP/PEEP, not if SBP < 90
  3. Shock, tamponade, dissection, AAA: recognize and transport fast

Next: cardiac monitoring and the 12-lead ECG
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: left heart failure floods the lungs, with crackles, orthopnea and frothy sputum; right heart failure swells the body. Two: the BC heart failure protocol: rest, sit up with the legs down, oxygen to ninety-four or higher, and assisted ventilations when needed; as a PCP, consider CPAP or a PEEP valve, but not with a systolic under ninety. Three: cardiogenic shock, tamponade, dissection and a ruptured aneurysm can't be fixed on scene. Recognize them, transport fast, and give no ASA or nitro for a dissection. Next lesson: cardiac monitoring and the twelve-lead ECG. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 收尾三句话。一，左心衰让肺里积水：湿啰音、端坐呼吸、泡沫痰；右心衰让全身水肿。二，BC 心衰流程：休息、坐直双腿下垂、给氧到九十四以上、需要时辅助通气；作为 PCP，考虑 CPAP 或 PEEP 阀，但收缩压低于九十时不用。三，心源性休克、心包填塞、主动脉夹层和腹主动脉瘤破裂都没法在现场解决：认出来、快速转运，夹层不给 ASA 和硝酸甘油。下节课讲心电监护和十二导联心电图。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
